name: DDIM (first-order)
tagline: Denoising diffusion implicit model: deterministic first-order ODE update, one model evaluation per step (CFG++ flavored).
diff_from_baseline: Song, Meng & Ermon, 'Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models' (ICLR 2021). First-order deterministic sampler — Tweedie estimate of $\hat{x}_0$ then linear DDIM update using the unconditional noise (CFG++ variant). Standard reference sampler.

name: DPM++ 2S (Heun's)
tagline: Second-order singlestep DPM-Solver++; predictor-corrector with Heun-style averaging, 2 model evals per step (10 steps under NFE=20).
pseudocode:
1. Halve timestep grid so 10 outer steps fit in NFE=20
2. At step $t$: $\hat{x}_0^{(t)} = (z_t - \sqrt{1-\alpha_t}\epsilon^{cfg})/\sqrt{\alpha_t}$
3. Euler proposal $z'_{t-h} = \sqrt{\alpha_{t-h}}\hat{x}_0^{(t)} + \sqrt{1-\alpha_{t-h}}\epsilon^{uc}$
4. Re-evaluate $\epsilon$ at $(z'_{t-h}, t-h)$ to get $\hat{x}_0^{(t-h)}$
5. Average estimates $\bar{x}_0 = \tfrac{1}{2}(\hat{x}_0^{(t)} + \hat{x}_0^{(t-h)})$ and update $z_{t-h} = \sqrt{\alpha_{t-h}}\bar{x}_0 + \sqrt{1-\alpha_{t-h}}\epsilon^{uc}$
6. On the final step fall back to Euler
diff_from_baseline: Lu et al., 'DPM-Solver++: Fast Solver for Guided Sampling of Diffusion Probabilistic Models' (2022). Singlestep second-order solver implemented as a Heun-style predictor-corrector on the data-prediction parameterization, with classifier-free-guidance-aware updates.

name: DPM++ 3M-SDE
tagline: Third-order multistep DPM-Solver++ in SDE form with Karras sigma schedule and Langevin churn ($\eta=1.2$); 1 NFE/step.
pseudocode:
1. Build Karras $\sigma$ grid ($\rho=7$) over $[\sigma_{\min}, \sigma_{\max}]$ with $T=20$ levels
2. At each step compute denoised $x_0 = D_\theta(z, \sigma)$ via Tweedie
3. Set $h = t(\sigma_{i+1}) - t(\sigma_i)$ with $t(\sigma)=-\log\sigma$ and $h_\eta = h(\eta+1)$
4. Exponential-integrator update: $z \leftarrow e^{-h_\eta} z + (1-e^{-h_\eta}) D_\theta$
5. Add 2nd/3rd-order Adams-style corrections from cached $D_\theta^{(i-1)}, D_\theta^{(i-2)}$
6. Inject Langevin noise with std $\sigma_{i+1}\sqrt{1-e^{-2h\eta}}$ when $\eta>0$
diff_from_baseline: Lu et al., 'DPM-Solver++' (2022); SDE/multistep variant popularized by k-diffusion (Karras sigma schedule, Karras et al. 2022). Third-order multistep exponential-integrator solver with Langevin renoising — strong reference for high-quality few-step sampling.
